title: Waxpol Universal Tractor Transmission Hydraulic & Wet Brake Oil 5L API GL-4 – 3-in-1 Multi-Purpose Fluid for Tractors,Agriculture & Off-road Equipment
description: Waxpol Universal Tractor Transmission Hydraulic and Wet Brake Oil is a fluid designed for use in transmissions, hydraulic systems, oil immersed brakes and other ancillary systems fitted to agriculture tractors and off-road equipment.It is formulated using specially selected additives and high quality base oils to provide good low temperature fluidity and wear protection and UTTO is recognised by leading agricultural equipment manufacturers and suitable for use in modern equipment. Operator comfort gets by responsive hydraulic performance and smooth gearshift performance from cold starts. Friction modifying additives ensure smooth, noise free operation of oil immersed brakes and Cleans the system.

specifications.Part Number: Tractor Oil and Wet Brake Oil 3-1 - 5 L
